editor_note: The men's hockey final against Malaysia starts at 15:30 IST, after this paper went to press. Readers wanting a second gold today will have to find out the old way.
house_note: India and Pakistan met for a gold medal and the scorecard read 211 to 192. Abhishek Sharma did most of the arithmetic in the first six overs.

lead.headline: India beat Pakistan by 19 runs to keep the Asian Games cricket gold
lead.short: Abhishek Sharma hit 61 from 28 balls, 52 of them in the powerplay, and Tilak Varma made an unbeaten 51 from 22 as India reached 211 for 6. Pakistan's Hasan Nawaz scored 96 from 51, but they finished on 192 for 6; Washington Sundar, Axar Patel and Shivam Dube took two wickets each.
more: It is India's second men's cricket gold in a row at the Games, after Hangzhou. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi became the youngest Indian to win an Asian Games gold. The senior side began the third ODI against West Indies in New Chandigarh at 14:00 IST, after winning the toss and batting.

why.text: A gold, and against Pakistan: the morning the whole country wanted.

update.new: India won the final against Pakistan by 19 runs.
update.front: The final's result is the day's biggest story on its own.

seconds.headline: UAE calls the cockpit attack terrorism; the co-pilot had been flagged as a security risk by Oman Air
seconds.byline: THE NATIONAL · ABC NEWS · BBC · 3 OCT
seconds.short: The UAE's prosecutor general said the co-pilot of flight FZ1073 attacked the Indian captain, Smit Machchhar, with the cockpit's crash axe and tried to seize the controls in an attempted terrorist act. US officials say the Omani co-pilot was suspended by Oman Air in 2024 as a trainee after extremist material was found in his possession.
more: Officials now say a reserve flydubai pilot travelling on the flight took the controls and landed at Tabuk after passengers and crew subdued the attacker; this paper reported on 1 October that the captain had landed the plane. Machchhar has been moved to Abu Dhabi for treatment.

why.text: If an airline missed a known risk, the questions reach every carrier's hiring checks, including India's.

update.new: The UAE calls it a terrorist act; the co-pilot had been flagged before; a reserve pilot landed the jet.
update.front: An official finding of terrorism, and a correction to how the plane was landed, are front-page news on their own.

seconds.headline: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump's export threat
seconds.short: The release follows US pressure on Europe to free its diesel reserves; Trump had threatened to ban US diesel exports unless it did, and he has since ruled the ban out.

why.text: More oil on the market eases the pressure on Brent, which India's fuel import bill follows.

briefs.headline: Nayara Energy raises petrol by ₹5 and diesel by ₹3 a litre at its pumps
briefs.text: The private refiner's increase applies at its own fuel stations.

briefs.headline: US adds just 29,000 jobs in September; unemployment rises to 4.2%
briefs.text: Economists had expected 84,000; July and August were revised down by 60,000 combined. Weak hiring cuts the odds of a US rate rise, which would ease the pressure on Indian shares and the rupee.

briefs.headline: Madrid's dossier asks UEFA to strip Barcelona of nine league titles, reports say
briefs.text: The titles are those Barcelona won between 2001 and 2018, the years of the €8.4 million payments to Negreira's companies, a day after UEFA confirmed its investigation continues. Barcelona deny trying to influence referees.

update.new: Reports say Madrid want nine Barcelona titles stripped.

briefs.headline: India play Brazil for the first time, at Salt Lake Stadium tonight
briefs.text: The friendly in Kolkata kicks off at 19:30 IST; Brazil's captain Marquinhos said his side are very happy to play India.

briefs.headline: Manchester City lodge their appeal, saying the ruling has errors of law and fact
briefs.text: City argue Abu Dhabi government money, not their owner's, helped sponsors pay. Rui Pinto, the whistleblower behind the leaks, is to lose his witness protection in Portugal despite death threats.

update.new: City formally lodged the appeal on Thursday night.

briefs.headline: Antonelli fastest in final practice; Verstappen second, qualifying under way at the cut
briefs.text: The championship leader lapped in 1m36.302s, nearly three tenths clear of Verstappen, after Mercedes fixed the problems that kept both cars off the pace on Friday. Hadjar was third and Russell fourth.

update.new: Mercedes recovered to top the last practice.

data.max_note: Second in final practice, three tenths off Antonelli.

briefs.headline: Alcaraz and Djokovic both into Sunday's quarter-finals
briefs.text: Alcaraz came back from 2–6 in a tiebreak to beat Matteo Arnaldi 7–6 6–1 and meets Denis Shapovalov in Tokyo. Djokovic came from a set down against Bu Yunchaokete, his 31st straight win in Beijing.

stories.headline: Women's hockey team end a 44-year wait for gold; Parveen and Ankush complete a boxing treble
stories.short: Lalremsiami's 10th-minute goal beat China 1–0 in the women's final, Savita Punia saved a penalty stroke, and the win also takes India straight to the 2028 Olympics. Parveen Hooda won the women's 65kg final 3–2 against an Olympic medallist and Ankush Panghal the men's 80kg 4–0, joining Lovlina: three boxing golds in one Games for the first time. India won six golds on Friday.
more: The men's hockey team play Malaysia for gold at 15:30 IST today, after the cut. India's tally reached 81 medals on Saturday.

why.text: India's best Games for boxing and women's hockey in a generation.

update.new: Women's hockey gold and two more boxing golds on Friday.

update.new: A protester died at the Mumbai rally.

briefs.text: The blast at TIL Healthcare in Tirupati district happened around 08:00; the cause is not yet known. The Prime Minister announced ₹2 lakh for each victim's family.
